entries.name: title
entries.label: Title
entries.description: Trip name / member name / plan-event-todo-packing-note title.

entries.name: body
entries.label: Notes
entries.description: Freeform note/body text -- the trip's own description, or a plan/note's content.

entries.name: kind
entries.label: Kind
entries.description: What this row IS -- the single discriminator every view filters on. `trip` = the one root row; `member` = a person on the trip; the rest are trip content.

entries.name: type
entries.label: Sync type
entries.description: Compatibility discriminator for the SHARE pipeline only -- isan's share_sink.dart levelMayPush() checks Dispatch's `type` vocabulary (kCommenterCreatableKinds), not tripboard's own `kind`. Stamped 'note' on note-kind rows ONLY (the sole tripboard kind with a real Dispatch counterpart), so a commenter-level collaborator can push their own notes; every other kind stays editor-gated in v1 (see MIGRATION.md). Never shown in the record editor (rules.hidden) -- this is plumbing, not user-facing data.

entries.name: status
entries.label: Status
entries.description: Done/open state for a todo or packing row. Unused on other kinds.

entries.name: date
entries.label: Date
entries.description: For an event: when it happens. Drives the Calendar.

entries.name: endDate
entries.label: End date
entries.description: Optional multi-day event end date.

entries.name: timeLabel
entries.label: Time
entries.description: For an event: a time-of-day label (e.g. 18:00).

entries.name: place
entries.label: Place
entries.description: For an event: a place name.

entries.name: lat
entries.label: Latitude
entries.description: For an event or note: pin location. Only rows with both lat and lon set show on the Map.

entries.name: lon
entries.label: Longitude
entries.description: For an event or note: pin location. Only rows with both lat and lon set show on the Map.

entries.name: weekLabel
entries.label: Week
entries.description: For a plan: which week bucket it belongs to on the Week board.

entries.name: assignee
entries.label: Assigned to
entries.description: For a todo or packing row: which member (a kind=member entry) it's assigned to.

entries.name: author
entries.label: Added by
entries.description: Which member (a kind=member entry) created this row -- stamped at creation from the per-install `tripboardMemberId` setting, NOT from sign-in identity (signing in must never change who a past row is attributed to). Empty means the device hadn't picked a member yet when the row was made -- shown as 'Unattributed', not an error or a raw id.

entries.name: color
entries.label: Color
entries.description: For a member: their chip color.

entries.name: emoji
entries.label: Emoji
entries.description: For a member: their chip emoji.

entries.name: url
entries.label: Link
entries.description: Optional reference link (booking confirmation, listing, map link, etc.).

entries.name: category
entries.label: Category
entries.description: Optional free-text tag (e.g. a packing category).

entries.name: updatedAt
entries.label: Updated
entries.description: The engine's own auto-stamped per-row write time (an ISO-8601 string, stamped by the reserved key name regardless of declared column type -- BoardState.addRow/setField/updateRow). DISPLAY-ONLY -- it is LWW-reserved and silently overwritten on every save, so it is never listed as an addRow/editable value (rules.hidden keeps it out of the record editor). Declared `text` (was `dateTime`) + `rules.date:true` so Activity's tag renders it humanized ("Jul 21, 11:05") instead of the raw ISO string -- renderer._valueLabel's rules['date'] branch only fires for a text-typed column (dateTime falls through to raw toString()); storage/sort are unaffected, same ISO string as before (see MIGRATION.md's designpass-0728 unit-3 entry for the compat note).

entries.name: createdBy
entries.label: Created by (sync)
entries.description: Signed-in PocketBase user id when signed in, else this install's stable local actor id (`board.settings['playerId']` falls back to `ThemeSettings.localActorId`, never empty) -- stamped `$playerId` at creation on every addRow action -- used ONLY by the sharing pipeline's per-row 'own row' gate (share_sink.dart's rowAuthoredBySelf / share_scope.dart's userRefFields default) so a commenter-level collaborator can push their own note. Separate from `author` (tripboard's own member-attribution column, which must never key off sign-in). Never shown in the record editor.

relations.name: fromId
relations.label: From
relations.description: The source node of this relationship (the trip root, for every edge in v1).

relations.name: toId
relations.label: To
relations.description: The target node of this relationship (the member/plan/event/todo/packing/note it links in).

relations.name: type
relations.label: Relationship
relations.description: `contains` is the only edge type v1 needs: structural trip-root -> item, walked by the share pipeline's subtree closure (mirrors Dispatch's `relations.type=contains` exactly).
